Triage notes (quick):
- Correlation: deployment of model v5 + quant profile q8-llm-v5-b at 08:37 PT to Meridian's serving pool.
- Observed: increased kernel contention and memory reclaims on the nodes serving Meridian (OOM-kicks not full OOMs). KV-cache hit rate for long session keys dropped ~18%. Safe-path generation token processing time up ~3–4x at peak.
- Metrics: p50 ~210ms (unchanged), p95 ~1.2s (from 220ms), error-rate jump to ~2.7% (mostly decode-time exceptions), throughput (tokens/s) -60% under 200 RPS synthetic test.

Immediate mitigations we can take now:
1) Revert the quant profile for Meridian's pool to q4-compat (expected rollback ~30min). This is the fastest known safety path.
2) If rollback is delayed, we can throttle client-side concurrency per-route and enable a conservative KV-cache warm-up (approx 12–15 minutes to see partial improvement).

I need explicit approval to start automated rollback to v4 artifact and to schedule a 10:30 PT maintenance window if needed. I will attach a short snapshot (meridian_incident_snapshot.png) to the incident.

Rishi
Principal Engineer, Inference Runtime
